reviewer.type: independent AI bilingual technical source reviewer
reviewer.method: Direct reading of the complete current English/Arabic message and all 145 named memberships in batches 0-49,50-99,100-144; direct semantic decisions authored by reviewer. Python used only for loading, wrapping, identity comparisons, hashes and serialization, not to generate judgments. No external model/completion calls.

guidanceExposure.originalA01ExposurePreserved: A repository-root grep intended to locate canonical OTP English source unexpectedly returned snippets from existing pl/ru/uk semantic review reports including Native text and dispositions. No such report was opened deliberately or used as translation guidance. This exposure occurred after direct reading of every assigned record and after identifying the OTP actor-owner issue. Subsequent searches were narrowed to src; findings cite inspected current English source. Strict no-other-Native-output exposure therefore cannot be claimed; parent must decide whether a fresh isolated re-review is needed.
guidanceExposure.freshClosureBoundary: The original A01 disclosure remains immutable and is not erased or reclassified. This reviewer did not read the foreign snippets. Current closure is a fresh own-Arabic PUBLICATION-family assessment grounded in current source, not a restamp of A01 or earlier A04 approval.
guidanceExposure.ownCatalogIncidentalExposure: During own-catalog structure inspection three unrelated own-Arabic message strings were displayed. They were not used as translation guidance and are outside closure scope. No foreign Native text was displayed. Effective comparison thereafter was limited to this family.

scope.familyCoverage: All 145 actual canonical members of schema 16159, not only the two original reported keys. No field is an attributeOperations.receive member; all are step detail.
scope.otherFamilies: POST, NAK/ACK, OTP forms, borrowed TGT and CIBA cue/scope are separate assigned families and are not accepted or closed by this report.

inputBindingEvidence.sampleMetadataNotApproval: Fresh sample producer success establishes identity only, not language quality.

sourceEvidence.meaning: Sole current source of the complete English caption; forbids private-key publication, constructs paired send/receive ops, and puts Publish in step-wide detail.

Import/receive-looking IDs call a.publish for signer-to-primary handoff, primary-to-signer public data, and uninstalled whole-zone candidate transfer.
All online-input compact proof branches publish authority-to-signer input; online-publish branches publish public signature back to authority.
